name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are Partial Cubes
scope: One-inclusion graphs with the source active-coordinate embedding.
statement: Every connected conditioning-minimal non-ample class has an irredundant isometric hypercube embedding; the containment in partial cubes is strict.
proof: The local-to-global geodesic argument proves that every member with at least three concepts is isometric in its ambient cube. The four-cycle is a partial cube but is ample, so it does not belong to this non-ample class.
